Title: Suresh and the Family

Cast

1. Suresh - 34 years, son
Look: white kurta-pyjama
2. Kavita - 27 years, daughter
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Meenakshi - 62 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
4. Sanjay - 64 years, father
Look: moustache, checked shirt
5. Vinod - 35 years, friend
Look: light beard, green T-shirt

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
3. The hospital ward - white beds, a drip stand

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kavita stands in the courtyard. Suresh and Sanjay stand near her.]

Suresh: "Kavita, what's the plan today?"

[Kavita washes clothes in a bucket.]

Kavita (surprised): "Suresh, look at this."

[Suresh dances at his sister's wedding.]

Suresh: "That's great!"

[Suresh showers flower petals on the couple.]

Sanjay: "And then?"

[Suresh spins cotton on the spinning wheel.]

Suresh: "Hey, look at that!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Suresh stands in the living room. Meenakshi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Sanjay: "Suresh, look over here."

[Suresh waves at his sister on a video call.]

Sanjay: "That's easy."

[Suresh takes a selfie with Mother.]

Meenakshi: "Yes, of course."

Scene 3: The hospital ward - Day

[Suresh stands in the ward. Meenakshi and Sanjay stand near him.]

Meenakshi: "Let's begin."

[Mother passes away, and Suresh covers her body with a white sheet.]

Suresh: "We will never forget you."
